title: Wiking WK-PS305 5-Port Gigabit PoE Switch 4x PoE 45W Unmanaged Network Switch

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Wiking WK-PS305 is a high-performance 5-Port Gigabit PoE Switch designed for small business networks, IP surveillance systems, and home office setups. Featuring 4 PoE+ ports and 1 Gigabit uplink port, this switch delivers both power and data over a single Ethernet cable, making installation simple and cost-effective.


With a 45W total PoE power budget, the WK-PS305 supports IEEE 802.3af/at standards, providing up to 30W per PoE port. It is ideal for powering IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and other PoE-enabled devices.


Key Features


  • 5 × 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 Gigabit Ports
  • 4 × PoE+ Ports (IEEE 802.3af/at)
  • Total PoE Power Budget: 45W
  • Up to 30W per PoE Port
  • 1 × Gigabit Uplink Port
  • Extend Mode up to 250 meters (10Mbps)
  • VLAN / Port Isolation Support
  • PoE Watchdog (Auto Device Restart)
  • Plug and Play Unmanaged Design
  • Durable Metal Casing
  • Fanless Silent Operation
